accounts.name: proof_record
docs: One record per (exchange, nullifier): a second proof from the same account in the same epoch fails here.

fields.name: amount
docs: Sum of proven balances, 6 decimals. A minimum, not the total.

types.name: ClaimBuffer
docs: Holds the claim info (provider, parameters, context) of a proof while it is uploaded in chunks; one Solana
transaction is too small for it. Closed by record_proof.

fields.name: observer
docs: Posts heartbeat + score reports. A single signer in v1 — said out loud in the README.

fields.name: attestors
docs: Ethereum addresses of the Reclaim attestors whose claim signatures are accepted.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: Devnet test-USDC mint used by every cover pool.

fields.name: challenge_window_secs
docs: Time between a trigger opening and becoming final, during which it can be cancelled.

fields.name: provider_hashes
docs: Reclaim provider hashes (claim context `providerHash`) accepted as proofs for this exchange.

fields.name: assets
docs: test-USDC the pool holds (deposits + premiums - withdrawals - payouts).

fields.name: cap_bps
docs: Max exposure as a share of assets.

fields.name: nullifier
docs: keccak(domain, exchange id, hashed account id, epoch) — never the account id itself.

fields.name: claim_ids
docs: Reclaim claim identifiers of the proofs that made this record.

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: sha256 of the evidence JSON in the repo; `verify` recomputes it.

types.name: SignedClaimArgs
docs: The signed part of a claim, passed as an instruction argument (the long claim info lives in the buffer).
